name: Takesi Inca trail
why: The best kept Inca road of Bolivia: stone paving over a 4,650 m pass and down into the green Yungas.
book: Small community fees. Transport from La Paz to Choquekota or Ventilla (2-3 h).
dangers: Altitude: La Paz is at 3,600 m; spend two or three days there before any hike.
The pass can be cold and foggy.
turnaround: Be on the pass by noon.

points.name: Choquekota
points.note: An Aymara village where the stone road begins.

points.name: Abra Takesi
points.note: The 4,650 m pass on the Inca paving.

points.name: Takesi
points.note: A small village of stone houses below the pass.

points.name: Kakapi
points.note: A hamlet in the green Yungas where the Inca road ends; Yanacachi is a short ride on.
